original_test_intent: Check that every approved OAM_1 sensor is present, healthy and coherently reported by Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record raw value, display precision, normalized unit, status and timestamp per physical OAM_1 sensor across each interface before computing deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines how continuously changing and differently rounded sensor views can be compared reproducibly.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No other OAM or static data can stand in for OAM_1 live sensors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A one-sample comparison validates reporting alignment, not thermal response over a workload transition.

expected_evidence: Approved OAM_1 sensor map and identity
Redacted raw outputs from Redfish, IPMI and ROCm
Raw/normalized values, status, age, delta and tolerance results
Logs, mismatch disposition, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All Master fields consistently request OAM_1 multi-interface sensors and Web parity; the incomplete DeepSeek command is not authoritative replacement coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The required map, tools and human confirmation are fulfillable prerequisites.

review_improvement: Adds precision-aware, time-bounded OAM_1 reconciliation and prevents a partial Redfish dump from passing the case.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Web page may round to whole degrees while Redfish exposes decimals and IPMI uses coarse conversion, so literal string equality would create false failures. Conversely, normalizing too aggressively can hide a real stale or misrouted channel. Retaining raw values and timestamps alongside approved precision-aware deltas distinguishes representation differences from sensor disagreement.
